summary: Parametric, plugin and path geometry become generator-owned sketch geometry. A sketch generator is a graph relation record { id, kind: "generator", idPrefix, name?, construction, geometry } whose geometry is a rectangle, circle, slot, polygon, path or plugin shape, as a legacy profile's was, a regular polygon directed by a line or axis, a circular pattern of sketch curves, or a linked offset of a closed chain of sketch curves. Only the record is stored. Every parse and every edit regenerates its members, real points, lines, arcs, circles and relations with ids <idPrefix>_<key>, keyed by their part of the shape and never by coordinates or sample order. A gear keys its members by tooth and part (t<k>_tip, t<k>_root, t<k>_flankL<n>s<i>, ...), a recipe by repetition and point (r<k>_v<i>), a circular pattern by occurrence and the seed it copies (i<k>_<seed id>), and a linked offset by the chain curve each edge follows (e_<id>, j_<id>, c_<id>); a resampled flank's chords take new keys while its ends, the tip and the root keep theirs. Members are fixed in the solver and owned: an edit of one is refused, naming the generator, until it is detached, while free geometry may relate to them. A driving dimension whose geometry is all generated, with the origin or an axis at most, is refused with owned-sketch-generator, naming the generators whose inputs set it, and Dimension and Make driving offer only its reference form. Changing a generator's inputs or a parameter regenerates its members in the same undo step; members that leave take the user relations on them through the S6 relation remap, and a relation the remap would remove stays until the edit confirms it with removedRelationIds, as a trim does: the profile editor, the parameter editor and Finish of a consumed-sketch edit show what it removes before Apply, and one refusal covers every relation in every sketch a parameter regenerates. An agent's refusal stays bounded: it gives the version, the count and up to 64 IDs not yet confirmed, and the same edit resent at that version with them confirmed lists the next, so a removal of any size can be confirmed exactly. A listed ID always fits, however many sketches share it; the rows placing it that do not fit are counted in omittedRelationRowCount, and a refusal message too long for the reply is shortened with its instruction kept whole. Agents preview a generator edit through a generator arm on the region proposal of cad_inspect_sketch_regions and cad_read_sketch_region_reference, which prepares and solves the edit as set-sketch-generator does, so free geometry tied to the members moves before the cells are read, and refuses an unconfirmed removal with the edit's details. cad_get_context lists set-sketch-generator, detach-sketch-generator and every generated shape, regular-polygon, circular-pattern and offset among them, and says that inputs size generated geometry. A listed polygon's or path's entries keep their ids through insertions, deletions, reorders and edits in place, so an inserted vertex reshapes only the edge it splits; entries changed where others are also inserted or removed take fresh ids unless the edit gives its own, so the relations on the ones they replace are confirmed, never moved to a guessed vertex. Saved legacy profiles load and stay editable, but every new shape is a generator: drawn shapes Fresh shape could not draw, plugin instances, DXF imports (one path or circle generator per contour) and agent-inserted shapes. An edit that gives a sketch a new saved profile fails with legacy-sketch-profile. A region whose boundary is exactly one generator's closed outline reads as the profile that generator replaces did, under its name and kind; any other closed loop reads as a path contour. On the canvas a generated shape is picked by its interior, gripped, dragged and opened from its context menu, by a right-click or the menu keys, as a saved profile was, each edit going to its inputs. Move profile and the rectangle Fillet write a generated shape's inputs, Dimension starts the Dimension tool, and commands a shape's edges cannot take are disabled and say why. A generated outline copied to an editable sketch keeps the relations among its edges. Offset loop gains a Linked choice that makes an offset generator, and offsets a generated shape, a plugin outline among them, picked by its interior or tree row as it offsets the loop of its edges. A linked offset follows at most 512 curves: a longer loop offsets only as an independent copy, and Linked says why. A generator listing more or fewer entries than its kind takes, an offset's chain of 1 to 512 curves, a circular pattern's 1 to 64 seeds, a polygon's 3 or more points or a path's 1 or more segments, is refused with invalid-sketch-generator, naming the generator, the bound and the count, from an edit, a stored document or cad_edit_document. A circular pattern's copies are checked for crossings with one another as the same edges drawn are. A generated sketch is shown, checked and captured without starting the sketch solver, one check generates each generator once, and a load accepts the members generation just made without checking each again; development checks, which every test suite turns on, check every item. Every editor that can remove relations this way asks first and applies the confirmed removal in one batch. A feature preview reports the removal set without applying it, a direct Length drag at such a value opens the Pad editor to ask, and building a feature input keeps its refusal.
warning: No breaking change for installed posts, machine packages, saved revisions or controller output. CAD documents gain an additive sketch relation kind, generator, and a sketch that holds a graph is written with schemaVersion 2 instead of 1. Documents saved before this release load unchanged: their saved profiles stay profiles and stay editable. New shapes, plugin instances, DXF imports and agent-inserted shapes are stored as generator records, which older builds of the app cannot open. A region reference to a generated void gains graphContours. Profile dimensions on a generator fail with the new code generator-sketch-dimension, whose message names the input that sets that size. A generated rectangle with a hole highlights its five edges one by one, where its saved profile highlighted two outlines. Generated geometry draws in the defined colour because it is fixed, where a saved profile drew in the profile blue. A press on a generated shape's edge selects that edge, which is sketch geometry; a press inside it selects the shape. A regular polygon has no grips or profile menu: its inputs editor sizes it. A DXF import with crossing contours is refused. A seed or chain curve of a circular pattern or linked offset cannot be deleted alone until the generator is detached. A linked offset's chain that cannot be offset exactly is refused with the code an independent offset gives, such as unsupported-sketch-offset, which sketches now declare. cad_edit_document now runs the domain's own refusals of an edit's unchecked data before its argument schema check: a reserved or fixed sketch id, or a generator list outside its bound, fails with reserved-sketch-id, fixed-sketch-element or invalid-sketch-generator and its reason, where it failed with INVALID_ARGUMENT. Other malformed edits still fail with INVALID_ARGUMENT and their schema issues.

checklist.schema: Additive CAD document change: the sketch graph relation union gains generator { id, kind, idPrefix, name?, construction, geometry }, whose geometry is a CAD profile geometry, a regular polygon { x, y, radius, sides, directionId }, a circular pattern { seedIds, centerId, count, angle } or a linked offset { chain: [{ entityId, reversed }], distance }. A polygon's or path's geometry may also store ids, one integer entry id per point or segment, written only when they differ from the indices after an insertion, deletion or reorder; they key its members so the entries kept keep their ids. The stored form holds the record alone; parsing regenerates its members and refuses carried members that differ, naming the generator (stale-sketch-generator). A sketch with a graph is written with schemaVersion 2. The edit schema gains set-sketch-generator and detach-sketch-generator, and set-sketch-generator and set-parameter gain optional removedRelationIds, the trim's confirmation field. Saved legacy profiles, UPID, post schema, machine packages, saved revisions, storage and journals are unchanged. Post engine API remains 1, saved-job engine remains 3 and CAD_PRECISION_VERSION stays 2.
checklist.events: No execution event, cancellation or input-version change. cad_edit_document runs the domain's pre-schema edit refusals, reserved and fixed sketch ids and generator list bounds, before its argument schema check, so those edits fail with the domain's code and reason instead of INVALID_ARGUMENT. Initial CAD discovery is 51,154 of its 51,200 UTF-8 bytes. The region proposal of cad_inspect_sketch_regions and cad_read_sketch_region_reference gains a generator arm, { generator, removedRelationIds? }, exclusive with the other arms; its targets are declared as open objects with a description instead of an empty properties table, and execution still validates each arm in full. cad_describe_edits describes set-sketch-generator and detach-sketch-generator. cad_construct_path's description now says to insert its geometry as a path generator and detach it to keep plain lines and arcs. New error codes: legacy-sketch-profile, generator-sketch-dimension, invalid-sketch-generator, owned-sketch-generator, stale-sketch-generator, unconfirmed-sketch-generator-removals (with details.relationIds, details.relations giving each relation's sketchId, and details.omittedRelationRowCount) and stale-sketch-generator-removals; sketches also declare unsupported-sketch-offset for a linked offset.
checklist.capabilities: No post or machine capability change. Rectangle, circle, slot, polygon, path and plugin tools and DXF import create generators; the profile editor and plugin panel edit a generator's inputs as they edited a profile, Edit shape edits a regular polygon's, a circular pattern's and a linked offset's inputs, and Detach turns its members into ordinary sketch geometry. Offset loop makes a linked offset generator when Linked is chosen.
checklist.auditAndOutput: No generation, audit, wrapper, numbering or controller-file change. Solids, sections and exports built from a generator match those built from the legacy profile it replaces, in every legacy kind and through a save and load.
checklist.installationAndStorage: Installed plugin packages are unchanged and keep their API; a plugin instance generates through the pinned package as before. Browser cache and folder adapters store the stored form, the generator records without members, and load documents saved before this release unchanged.
checklist.verification: Full Vitest, build, lint, ui:check, check-release and each affected Playwright spec on its own, run before review is requested.

publicNotes.summary: Sketch shapes, gears and imported paths become generators: shapes you can resize from their inputs that stay real sketch geometry.
changes: New rectangles, circles, slots, polygons, paths and plugin shapes such as gears are generators. Their edges and points are sketch geometry you can relate free geometry to, and their inputs, numbers or parameter expressions, size and place them.
Changing a generator's inputs or parameters regenerates its geometry in one undo step. Teeth, sides and repetitions that remain keep their relations.

When a change would remove relations on geometry a shape no longer has, every editor that can make it asks first: it lists them, Apply removes them in the same undo step, and Cancel keeps them. This covers the shape and parameter editors, sketch fields and dimensions, the pattern and profile forms, feature forms such as Pad, and Finish of a sketch edit. A Length dragged to such a value applies nothing and opens the Pad's editor to ask.

Click inside a generated shape to edit its inputs, or use its grips, drag it, or right-click it for its profile menu, as with saved profiles. Edit shape, on a selected shape's edge or point, opens the same inputs, including a regular polygon's centre, radius, number of sides and direction line.
A DXF import makes one generated path or circle for each closed contour.
Offset loop can make a linked offset that follows its loop and distance, and a circular pattern of sketch curves keeps its count, angle and centre editable. Both are generators.
Offset loop works on a generated shape or plugin outline picked by its inside or its tree row. A loop of more than 512 curves offsets as an independent copy, and Linked says why it is unavailable.
Move and Fillet on a generated shape change its inputs, and toolbar commands that do not apply to a generated shape are disabled with the reason.
Copy outline to editable sketch keeps the relations among a generated outline's edges.
Detach turns a generator's geometry into ordinary lines, arcs and points.
Saved profiles load and stay editable as before.
publicNotes.compatibility: Installed machine packages, posts, saved revisions and controller output are unchanged. Parts with new generator shapes need this version or later to open.
